_about: Steve edits this file. It's shown when someone taps a glacier or permanent snowfield that isn't part of a ski zone. Gentle glacier terrain is the way in, not a zone (Steve, 2026-11-11). Placeholder wording for Steve to rewrite.
title: Glacier
paragraph: Glacier or permanent snow. Gentle glacier terrain is shown as the way in, not as a ski zone.
bullets: Crevasses can hide under fresh snow, even on low-angle ice. Rope up and carry crevasse rescue gear.
Glacier travel and crevasse rescue are skills to learn on a course before the trip, not on the day.
Snow bridges weaken as the day warms and through the spring.
sourceNote: Outlined from ESA WorldCover 2021 satellite land cover. Glacier edges shift every year, and crevasse fields aren't mapped.
